name: import-sorter
description: Sorts and groups imports in TypeScript/JavaScript files like Python's isort: Node built-ins, installed packages, then your own files.

importSorter.sortOnSave.description: Sort imports automatically when a file is saved.

importSorter.groups.description: Order of import groups. An entry can be a single group or an array of groups that share one section. Groups: sideEffect, builtin, external, internal, parent, sibling, index, relative (= parent + sibling + index), style, type.

importSorter.internalPatterns.markdownDescription: Module prefixes treated as your own code (the `internal` group), e.g. `@/`, `~/`, `@myorg/`. Wrap in slashes for a regex, e.g. `/^@(app|lib)\//`. Aliases from `tsconfig.json`/`jsconfig.json` `paths` and `baseUrl` are detected automatically.

importSorter.detectTsconfigPaths.markdownDescription: Read `paths` and `baseUrl` from the nearest `tsconfig.json`/`jsconfig.json` to detect internal aliases.

importSorter.groupHeadings.markdownDescription: Optional comment written above each group (like isort's `import_heading_*`). Example: `{ "builtin": "Node", "external": "Third party", "internal": "Project" }`.

importSorter.blankLinesBetweenGroups.description: Number of blank lines between import groups.

importSorter.sortSpecifiers.description: Sort named imports inside braces: import { a, b, c } from 'x'.

importSorter.mergeDuplicates.description: Merge multiple imports from the same module into one statement.

importSorter.removeUnused.description: Remove imported names that are never referenced in the file. Side-effect imports are never removed.

importSorter.sortSideEffects.description: Sort side-effect imports (import 'x'). Off by default because their order can matter (polyfills, CSS).

importSorter.maxLineLength.description: Wrap named imports onto multiple lines when a statement is longer than this. 0 disables wrapping.

importSorter.semicolons.description: Whether import statements end with a semicolon. 'preserve' follows what the file already does.

importSorter.trailingComma.description: Add a trailing comma after the last specifier in wrapped (multi-line) imports.

importSorter.bracketSpacing.description: Print spaces inside braces: { a } instead of {a}.

importSorter.styleExtensions.description: Side-effect imports ending in these extensions go into the 'style' group.

scripts.test: npm run tsc -- -p tsconfig.json --outDir out && node --test "out/test/**/*.test.js"

//: typescript@7 (native, Go) is the compiler for this project. It has no in-process parser API, so the sorter parses with 'typescript-api' (TypeScript 6, the last JS release), bundled into dist/.
